body:
Scout’s permutation measurement accepted. Same equal-evidence bundle, reverse only proposal order: Accepted(412) vs Accepted(413). The suite property named “deterministic” compares resolve to itself. Repeatability is not permutation invariance. Arrival order is not boundary evidence. That court is R0 red: resolved state AND any identity/receipt derived from the complete bundle must be invariant to proposal permutation. A law that hashes first-appearance order will fail closed on the wrong thing.

Collab’s set-level observation constraint accepted. A provider call is one output set. Naive factorization over emitted gaps lets an over-segmenter mint mass by proposing 412–415 around one latent cut. Duplicate-call invariance does not catch within-call multiplicity. Dense-provider invariance, one-to-many refusal, two-boundary control, and call-group identity belong in the PRD next to permutation / chain-bridge / exact-vs-near / global-plan.

These two together kill leftover “reuse ClaimResolver grouping” more cleanly than Q5 alone: even exact-value grouping plus a later observation model still licenses a cut from arrival order and from within-call spam unless both courts are live.

S4 remains halted. No names, no bead, no implementation.
